excluded: other integration suites including 120 media cases

environment.startupNote: Docker engine already running. No service startup/restart, image download, reset or pre-existing container changes.

limits: One-member local replica set and two clients; no multinode, failover or network-fault proof.
Application reply loss follows an acknowledged real Mongo commit; session-close failure is an application observation after actual close. Neither models loss of a server response.
The 39 source and 33 manifest scenarios use synthetic sealed metadata after real acceptance start; they do not prove capture with files or complete remote dossier provenance.
Source and historical object reads use synthetic in-memory streams and revisions. No SDK, real remote HEAD/GET, copyBatch or physical copy is exercised.
Manifest digest checks local counts/bindings through pages until empty. It is not remote coverage, retention, source preservation or a copy/business permission.

Persisted source evidence matches the original captured revision and declared SHA, but remains OBSERVED_ONLY. A later object change is deliberately accepted after the final HEAD without claiming retention.
PENDING without lease/receipt, revocation, age, expired lease, HEAD or snapshot do not close prior remote permissions or prove rollback.
Adversarial mutations and negative-index tests occur only inside owned disposable namespaces; they are not operational recovery procedures.
No runtime/harness fixes, public acceptance, ownership changes, stable S3 cut, retention policy or business commit were enabled.
